note: Seen on the apply pages of two public Lever postings on two boards (a Lever demo board and one company board), opened read-only with headless Chromium that aborted every request but GET. Both behaved the same, no employer is named here, and nothing was typed but a generic city name into the Location field. Every entry has a confirmed flag: true means it was seen on those pages, false means the spec pins it and no page showed it (the EU host, the upload path). The hCaptcha and Cloudflare requests below were all made by the page by itself, at load, before anyone pressed anything.
static_asset_note: jobs.lever.co serves its own scripts (application.js, parseResume.js, retrieveLocations.js, jquery, debounce, cookieconsent, bug-snag.js) and its logo. cdn.lever.co served only fonts. The S3 bucket served the company's logo (one picture per board). jobs.eu.lever.co is expected to serve the same paths and was not opened.
